title: Service Bus, Event Grid, and Cosmos DB
description: Use Azure messaging and NoSQL services from C# — Service Bus, Event Grid, and Cosmos DB.
longDescription: Modern cloud apps need reliable messaging, event routing, and scalable NoSQL storage. This module covers Azure Service Bus for enterprise messaging, Event Grid for event-driven routing, and Cosmos DB for globally distributed document storage — all from C#.
whatYouLearn: Send and receive messages with Azure Service Bus from C#
Publish and subscribe to events with Event Grid
Create and query documents in Cosmos DB using the Azure SDK
